removeDescription: The configuration and saved passwords for {{name}} will be deleted and the integration will stop working.
deactivateDescription: {{name}} will not be used until it is activated again. The configuration is kept.

test.title: Test connection
test.description: The test uses the saved configuration. Save your changes before testing.
test.sendEmail: Also send a test email to me

form.title: Configure {{name}}
form.secretConfigured: Already configured. Leave blank to keep the current value.

validation.url: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.versionConflict: The configuration was changed by someone else. Close and reopen it to see the current version.

smtp.name: Organization SMTP
smtp.description: Send the organization's emails (notifications and invitations) through your own SMTP server instead of Aphel's default server. Sign-in and password recovery emails still go through the default server.

host.label: Server
host.help: SMTP server address, for example smtp.yourcompany.com.

security.label: Security
security.help: Use STARTTLS on port 587 and TLS on port 465. None only for internal servers.

username.label: Username
username.help: Leave blank if the server does not require authentication.

password.label: Password
password.help: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

from_email.label: Sender email
from_email.help: Address shown as the sender. The server must allow sending from it.

from_name.label: Sender name
from_name.help: Optional, for example your company name.

webhook.name: Generic webhook
webhook.description: Send CRM events to any HTTPS address. Endpoints are managed on the webhooks screen.
